summary: Two out-of-state hikers in tennis shoes climbed Mount of the Holy Cross; on descent one separated from his partner and was lost; ground crews began searching the next day as 18 inches of snow fell; HAATS OH-58A inserted six searchers and a dog at a 12,500-ft landing zone in whiteout conditions; the hiker was found near a ground crew, treated for hypothermia and ankle frostbite, and survived
location: Mount of the Holy Cross, ~12,500 ft landing zone
responding_agency: HAATS (Colorado Army National Guard), ground SAR teams
notes: UNVERIFIED — retain in pending. Reviewed October 6, 2026: Army article confirms this rescue but says only mid-October, without specifying an incident year or day.
